main_text.p: Tacet nobiles illos decem Articulos in Edamenfi Synodo ab ipfius Fratribus cufos, plerofque tam crudos, ut ipsæ Borealis Hollandiæ Classes in sequenti Alcmariana Synodo, eos emendare atque emollire necessum putaverint. Obtrudebantur scil. illi articuli ut via pacis, atque ut tales à Classibus in Australi Hollandia tandem fuere receptæ.

Videbatur itaque in illa Hollandiæ parte res composita, restabant Australis Hollandiæ Classes undecim: ad quas per ordinarios Synodi Deputatos Auctoritate publica decem illi articuli mittuntur eo fine, ut omnia singularum Classium membra illos examinarent atque expenderent, &, si salvâ fide & conscientiâ illæsâ fieri posset, pacis gratia eos amplectèrentur, quò sic pari passu incederent cum Fratribus Hollandiæ Borealis Ecclefiarum Ministris.
Summa votorum Classium Australis Hollandiæ ad Synodum Leerdamensem delatorum Anno cıↄ ıↄ cıxxv. hæc fuit.

page.notes: Scan is slightly blurred; the bottom line "Anno cIↄ Iↄ CLXXV" is printed with reversed-C numerals and rendered as MDCLXXV in the Roman form intended; the "D 3" signature and "fuit." sit on the last line. Marginal show-through and small marks at the right edge were ignored. Some letters of "sequenti", "Obtrudebantur", and "illæsâ" are slightly uncertain but read as printed.
